scope: Completely offline post-v8 development audit of all 360 outputs, not new model experiments or held-out validation

inputs.labels: Reuse frozen v8 replay and v7 stage tables only; no new manual labels or rule parsing

available_inputs: model/direct or program-derived proposal when present
rules: field coverage by at least one player per phase ONLY under current public/player_0/player_1 language; configurable off for other observation languages
candidate or witness must be consistent with own declared table when available
local_checks.outputs: reject_local or locally_consistent_unverified; semantic_certification_allowed=false in all cases; never claim no local error means correct

denominators: all known failures and retained nonfailures
analysis.primary: local detection vs frozen reference errors, false local rejection of reference-correct controls, residual semantic mismatches
analysis.false_certification: Report how many wrong tables would be mis-certified IF locally consistent were promoted; actual checker never issues semantic approval
analysis.audit_controls: All12 frozen reference tables plus every single field/phase/player visibility bit flip (192 derived mutations); not new manually authored truth or independent game samples
analysis.limits: Designed after v8 failures; detection rates on reused development data do not establish generalization. Remaining wrong owner or missed disclosure requires rule evidence; cannot infer natural-language truth from internal consistency.
